site.name: Shreya Mondal
site.headline: Hi, I'm Shreya
site.introduction: Driven by a belief that continuous learning is one of the most meaningful personal growth challenges one can embrace, my curiosity sits at the intersection of technology and finance. I enjoy acquiring new tools, developing technical skills to bring ideas to life, and exploring how data can help us understand financial markets and build better investment research workflows.
site.contact_heading: Have a thoughtful problem to solve?
site.contact_copy: I'm interested in opportunities and conversations around financial data, research, analytics, and technology-driven products.

projects.title: Audience Demand Prediction System
projects.description: Combined booking, theatre, and audience datasets; engineered time-series, lag, rolling, and cyclical features to identify demand patterns. Compared regression models and generated future audience forecasts using Random Forest.

projects.title: Campus Placement Management System
projects.description: A full-stack placement management application with role-based workflows for students, companies, and administrators. Includes REST APIs, authentication, relational data models, and CRUD workflows.

projects.title: AI-Powered Code Generation & Deployment
projects.description: An automated application generation and deployment pipeline using AI models, FastAPI, and the GitHub API. Generates web applications, creates repositories, deploys to GitHub Pages, and supports iterative updates.

projects.title: Financial data & document intelligence
projects.description: Exploring ways to turn complex financial and business information into structured, queryable datasets — combining document extraction, data validation, analytical workflows, and useful interfaces.

capabilities.intro: I’m interested in building AI-powered B2B software products that automate complex enterprise workflows — especially across financial data and investment research.

items.title: Research & problem framing
items.description: Break down business and analytical questions, understand the underlying data, and translate requirements into a clear problem to solve.

items.title: Data & modelling
items.description: Clean and structure datasets, explore patterns, build analytical workflows, and apply statistical or predictive methods where useful.

items.title: Tools & implementation
items.description: Translate analytical requirements into usable software: Python workflows, APIs, AI-enabled document and data systems, and interfaces for enterprise teams.

background.intro: An interdisciplinary foundation across economics, finance, data science, and quantitative finance — applied to financial datasets, investment research, and technology-led problem solving.
